opening.argument: The video presents flash-loan arbitrage through Remix and Solidity as a profit method, then gives viewers the operational steps to pursue it. It instructs them to deploy a contract, call the "flashloan" function, connect MetaMask to Avalanche Mainnet, and send "$200 of Avalanche/AVAX to the contract for gas fee for all swaps." The earnings pitch is reinforced by the claim that viewers can "EARN MORE THAN THE AMOUNT IN THE VIDEO" by increasing the gas fee, while a conversion page displays 99.4995 AVAX as 1,772.85 USD. Those instructions and apparent returns encourage viewers to transfer funds into a contract, yet the contract's behavior, recipient control, and reproducibility of the displayed result are not verified; the frame showing a proposed 11.23 AVAX transaction does not establish completion.
